\[
M_{sp}=\pi_{sp}^*L,
\qquad
M_{face}=\pi_{face}^*L,
\qquad
M_{sp}^2=M_{face}^2=8.
\]

```text
Stage19 physical M4 curves = absent
Stage19 odd physical M-degrees = absent
Stage20 Saunderson physical M-degree = 6
Stage19 physical M6 absence = not proved
```
